From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Rishi — quick summary from security/assurance: our most recent Type II report covers Apr 1 2025 - Mar 31 2026. That does not exactly match Finex's requested Jan 1 2025 - Dec 31 2025 window, but there is 9 months overlap and our controls and continuity statements are consistent across quarters.

Options (fastest to slowest):
- Option A (fastest): Issue an interim attestation letter signed by our Head of Security that maps the requested Jan-Dec 2025 window to the report period and calls out evidence availability. Includes an evidence matrix with representative artifacts. Target: same-day or next-business-day turnaround.
- Option B: Produce a short bridge letter from legal + security that explains coverage gap and attests controls were in place for Jan-Feb 2025. Target: 2 business days.
- Option C: If Finex requires the formal Type II specifically for that exact period, we'd need to re-run some evidence collection and coordinate with auditor — estimate 3-4 weeks (not acceptable for Monday).

I recommend Option A immediately. Deliverables: 1) interim attestation PDF, 2) one-page evidence matrix (minimal), 3) network diagram screenshot. I can draft the attestation and evidence matrix if Soojin can confirm availability of the referenced artifacts.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Alice D'Souza <alice.dsouza@finex.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:05:46 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II availability + audit period clarification

Thanks Rishi / Marissa — Option A sounds workable for our procurement committee. Two clarifications: 1) the attestation needs to explicitly reference the Jan 1 2025 - Dec 31 2025 period and state which controls are asserted, and 2) the evidence matrix needs to include at minimum the control owner and one artifact link (logs, change control, or configuration snapshots).

If you can upload the attestation + matrix to our portal (procure@finex.com) by Monday EOD, we can keep the fast path. If you hit blockers, we will consider a 48-hour exception from the committee but prefer to avoid that.

Appreciate the speedy coordination.

Best,
Alice
